'''Pink''' was a species of [[Algae/Legends|algae]] native to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] that caused the [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] they lived in to have a [[Color/Legends|rosy]] tint.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
